name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Clean
description: Clean the bell from the floor or hang to the rack and catch it BOTTOMS-UP — bell balanced over a vertical forearm at shoulder height — instead of letting it rest on the forearm. The catch demands an instant hard grip and a packed shoulder or the bell tips. Soft knees absorb the catch, wrist stays straight and stacked. Trains the clean plus bottoms-up stabilization in one move. Light bell — the balanced catch is the whole skill.
